Package org.apache.cayenne.project.xml

Class QueryDescriptorHandler

java.lang.Object
org.xml.sax.helpers.DefaultHandler
org.apache.cayenne.project.xml.SAXNestedTagHandler
org.apache.cayenne.project.xml.NamespaceAwareNestedTagHandler
org.apache.cayenne.project.xml.QueryDescriptorHandler
All Implemented Interfaces:
ContentHandler, DTDHandler, EntityResolver, ErrorHandler
Direct Known Subclasses:
ProcedureQueryDescriptorHandler, SelectQueryDescriptorHandler, SQLTemplateDescriptorHandler
public abstract class QueryDescriptorHandler extends NamespaceAwareNestedTagHandler
A base of the handlers of the query tags of a DataMap. A subclass per query type reads its own tag into the matching QueryDescriptor. The base reads the attributes common to all the query tags.
Since:
4.1
